Tapu Lele

Psychic Fairy

Alola · Generation 7 · Legendary Pokémon

Tapu Lele is a Psychic/Fairy-type Land Spirit Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 18.6 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (130), with a base stat total of 570.
